dct_description_sm: During the 2007-2008 CFL IPY Project, the research icebreaker CCGS Amundsen overwintered in the South Beaufort Sea/Amundsen Gulf flaw lead system.  The purpose of this experiment was to comprehensively study the flaw lead system through an entire annual cycle.  This dataset provides a summary of basic meteorological variables throughout the CFL project.  The purpose of these measurements is to provide part of the physical context for the various atmospheric, oceanographic, chemical and biological processes which were examined by the various investigators involved in the CFL study.
dct_title_s: Ship-Based Meteorological Data, 2007-2008 CFL IPY Project
